from pyspark.sql import Window, functions as F

online_orders = spark.createDataFrame([["C001", "West", "Online", "2026-01-12", "SKU-A-100", "1200", "4"], ["C001", "West", "Online", "2026-02-03", "SKU-A-140", "640", "1"], ["C002", "East", "Online", "2026-03-09", "SKU-A-100", "990", "2"]], ["CustomerID", "Region", "Channel", "OrderDate", "SKU", "Amount", "Units"])
other_channels = spark.createDataFrame([["C002", "East", "Store", "2026-01-18", "SKU-B-220", "840", "2"], ["C003", "North", "Partner", "2026-02-11", "SKU-C-010", "2100", "6"], ["C004", "South", "Store", "2026-03-01", "SKU-B-220", "430", "3"], ["C005", "West", "Partner", "2026-03-21", "SKU-C-010", "150", "1"], ["C003", "North", "Store", "2026-04-02", "SKU-A-140", "1760", "5"]], ["CustomerID", "Region", "Channel", "OrderDate", "SKU", "Amount", "Units"])
tag_online = online_orders.withColumn("SourceStream", F.lit("Online"))
tag_other = other_channels.withColumn("SourceStream", F.lit("Other"))
stack_channels = tag_online.unionByName(tag_other, allowMissingColumns=True)
amount_number = stack_channels.withColumn("AmountNum", F.col("Amount").cast('double'))
amount_by_channel = amount_number.groupBy(*["Region"]).pivot("Channel").agg(F.sum(F.col("Amount").cast('double')))

display(amount_by_channel)
